The Inn at Stonecliffe
Your Elevated Escape Awaits
Step into a place where history whispers through every detail and modern comfort elevates every moment. At The Inn at Stonecliffe, timeless charm is more than a feeling—it’s a way of welcoming you in. Relax into expansive views, thoughtful amenities, and a heritage reimagined.
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
Vacation for a Cause
The Pulte Family Charitable Foundation proudly owns three Humanitarian Hotels, which offer exceptional accommodations while making a positive impact. We donate every dollar of net profit to charitable causes. Guests aren’t simply booking a room, but joining a mission to empower communities through programs that offer dignified employment, and support non-profits in areas like food rescue, refugee employment, affordable housing, and education.
Learn More
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
Property Events and Activities
Explore our thoughtfully curated events and activities on our property. As part of the resort fee there are complimentary scheduled activities each week for guests staying at Stonecliffe. From our signature fudge & wine tastings to hands-on pizza-making and creative art classes, there’s always something to enjoy.
View Property Activities
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
TIME's 2024 World's Greatest Places
The Inn at Stonecliffe has been selected as one of TIME’s 2024 World's Greatest Places . We are incredibly honored to join this storied collection, as the recognition succinctly captures the unique experience we strive to provide for our guests here on Mackinac Island.
Learn More
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
Our Idyllic
Grounds
Immerse yourself in an enclave of natural beauty, within expansive grounds featuring winding paths, open fields, beautiful gardens, and the most elevated and privileged view on the island: The graceful span of Mackinac Bridge suspended over the straits connecting Lake Huron and Lake Michigan. The grass is indeed greener here. Please note that our property is not pet-friendly.
Preview Renovated Grounds
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
Our Inspired Amenities
Thoughtful and engaging, our list of amenities rises above the standard guest room conveniences. From a brand-new wellness center and The Backyard, designed for deliciously social gatherings to live music on the Straits Lawn, there’s something for everyone at The Inn at Stonecliffe — all without leaving our grounds.
Learn More
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
A Landmark, Reimagined
We are delighted to welcome guests to a reimagined Stonecliffe experience. Our extensive renovations have fully updated the guest rooms and bathrooms in both the Mansion and Summer House, introduced new family-friendly cottages, and added an Event Center, General Store, Bike Pavilion, Wellness Center, and more. These enhancements blend historic charm with modern elegance, creating a refreshed, luxurious atmosphere. We look forward to welcoming you to experience these updates and to discover the unparalleled magic of Mackinac Island.
Take a Tour
About Us
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
Our Storied Mansion
Whether you want to book a romantic weekend with your partner or plan an activity-filled getaway with a friend, the fully renovated mansion at the heart of Stonecliffe offers 16 mindfully updated rooms that preserve the home’s authenticity while offering modern amenities.
Take a Tour
View Accommodations
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
Our Private Enclave in the Bluffs
Though only two miles from the center of town, The Inn at Stonecliffe feels blissfully separate from its commotion. We stand alone among Mackinac Island mansions. Quieter. More understated. Profoundly connected to our island’s inherent natural beauty, magnificent views, and deep cultural history.
A One-Of-A-Kind Experience
Bike Around Mackinac
Mackinac Island features a detailed network of biking trails, perfect for exploring the stunning vistas or pedaling downtown to check the scene. Whether it’s a solo excursion or a ride with the family, our bike rentals will gear you up for a wonderful time and keep you active during your stay.
Learn More
Rooms Overview
Mansion
Every guest room in our fully restored 1904 Mansion features thoughtful renovations that will elevate your stay without losing sight of its historic charm. Delight in the home’s Tudor architecture, even as you enjoy the comforts of AC, elegantly modern bathrooms, and luxe designer finishes specifically designed for Stonecliffe.
View Accommodations
Rooms Overview
Summer House
Discover the supreme comfort of staying in a freshly revitalized suite that offers thoroughly renovated bathrooms, a kitchenette, and a bright, summery patio. Allow each member of your group room for privacy even as they find plenty of space to make the most of their vacation time together.
View Accommodations
Rooms Overview
Private Cottages
Enjoy a completely private experience at one of our brand-new cottages. Each of our three-bedroom cottages features two and half bathrooms, a full kitchen, a living room, and a front porch that opens up to views of the Straits of Mackinac and our picturesque grounds. It’s the perfect spot to get away with the whole family.
View Accom

The Inn at Stonecliffe
Our Story
Set two miles from the clamor of downtown, The Inn at Stonecliffe is your own private enclave on Mackinac — a joyful, effortless, lakeside luxury retreat, recently selected as one of TIME’s 2024 World's Greatest Places , where you’ll experience the very best of the island in a setting of striking natural beauty. The authentic character and ambiance here are easy yet energized, with plenty to do for everyone.
View Property Features
Journey Through Time
A New Chapter
After a 2 year transformation of the property, The Inn at Stonecliffe welcomed guests back in June 2024. Starting with the historic Mansion, there are 16 fully renovated guest rooms adding modern comforts while respecting the property’s historic charm. We also updated Summer House accommodations which has 32 guest rooms and added 3 brand-new private cottages.
Take a Video Tour
Journey Through Time
Our History
Built in 1904 by famed architect Frederick Perkins, The Inn at Stonecliffe started out as part of a 150-acre family estate. It changed hands multiple times, going from a politically savvy couple that made the first major property additions to an organization that held summer conferences and a small college whose students cleared a downhill ski slope for themselves. We are now a Humanitarian Hotel proudly part of the Pulte Family Charitable Foundation where 100% of our proceeds go to charitable initiatives both locally and globally.
Journey Through Time
Creating Memories
Offering 3,000 square feet of flexible event space, our brand-new Sunset Pavilion Event Center is designed to become the center of all gatherings at The Inn at Stonecliffe. With its modern amenities, it is primed to become the venue of choice for local community events, grand weddings, and company meetings that aim to include a personal touch to business-minded functions.
Take a 360 Tour of our Sunset Pavilion
Journey Through Time
Renovating The Mansion
Our Mansion has undergone deep interior renovations that showcase its historical details. Experience an elevated take on a beloved overnight experience. Exterior renovations include a new landscaped garden grove in the front of the Mansion and a new brick patio with a fountain centerpiece out back.
Take a Tour
Journey Through Time
Additional Accommodations
Families and groups of friends can comfortably stay together in the renovated suites located inside our Summer House or experience a stay in 1 of our 3 brand-new private cottages that can accommodate up to 10 guests. All our Summer House rooms were updated with modern appointments. Each of our cottages features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, walk-in closets, an open-concept common area with a full kitchen, living room, and private porch. With our recent renovations we are not a pet-friendly property.
Take a Tour
Journey Through Time
Restoring the Apple Orchard
With its shaded grassy paths between mature apple trees, our historic orchard has always been a sweet retreat. By renovating and adding new trees to the existing orchard on recently purchased acreage below the lawn area, we are doing our part to keep this treasured spot alive and thriving. In addition to cultivating multiple apple varieties that can eventually be used in our dining program, we are also raising honey bees in orchard hives.
Journey Through Time
Making a Community Impact
As part of the Pulte Family Charitable Foundation, our commitment to supporting meaningful initiatives for communities in need extends beyond hospitality. By giving away 100% of our net profits, donating excess food, and providing affordable housing for employees, among other efforts, we strive to make a difference in Northern Michigan and around the globe. View more information about our Humanitarian Hotel.
Learn More

The Inn at Stonecliffe
We've Got Answers
Thank you for choosing The Inn at Stonecliffe for your Mackinac Island getaway. Nestled on the tranquil west bluff, just two miles from the bustle of downtown, our historic property offers a secluded setting with panoramic views of the Straits. We look forward to welcoming you and hope the information below helps you plan a seamless and memorable island stay.
About Inn at Stonecliffe
What makes The Inn at Stonecliffe unique?
Stonecliffe is a historic property on Mackinac Island located on the west bluff with sweeping views of the Straits of Mackinac and Mackinac Bridge. We blend historic charm with modern comfort, expansive grounds, curated on-site activities, and dining, all while operating as a Humanitarian Hotel where 100% of net profits support local and global causes.
Where is Stonecliffe located on the island?
The Inn at Stonecliffe is located about 2 miles from downtown Mackinac Island on the west side. The setting offers tranquility and elevated views away from the hustle and bustle of Main Street.
Is the property pet-friendly?
For the comfort and safety of all guests, pets are not permitted anywhere on the property.
What amenities are available on property?
Guests can enjoy complimentary wi-fi throughout the property, 2 seasonal outdoor pools, 24 hour wellness center and fitness area, on-site bike rentals, concierge and luggage services, coffee and water throughout their stay, multiple dining options (The Straits, The Backyard, Horsey’s Pub, General Store) and lawn games and fire pits with daily s’mores (weather dependent).
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in begins at 4:00pm and check-out is 11:00am.
What is your cancellation or deposit policy?
Cancellation and deposit policies vary by rate; details are provided at booking. Please refer to your reservation terms or contact us for specifics.
What forms of payment are accepted?
We accept major credit cards. A credit card is required at check-in, and full payment may be due upon arrival. We are a cashless property. Please plan accordingly should you wish to show appreciation to our service staff.
Can children stay at Stonecliffe?
Yes, we are a family-friendly property. We have a family-friendly pool and activities for kids. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. We do not offer child services.
Are there any smoking or noise policies?
The Inn at Stonecliffe is a non-smoking property. In accordance with Michigan State Law, the use of tobacco products are strictly prohibited in all indoor and outdoor guest areas, including guest rooms. The use of medical and recreational marijuana is strictly prohibited at The Inn at Stonecliffe as well. Outdoor wedding events and similar gatherings are required to conclude by 10pm. Quiet hours are respected to ensure comfort for all guests and our neighbors.
How do I get to Stonecliffe from the ferry docks?
Since cars aren’t allowed on Mackinac Island, guests arrive via foot, bike, or horse-drawn carriage. We offer a complimentary Stonecliffe shuttle from the ferry docks upon arrival and departure (Guest services team will provide schedule prior to arrival).
Is luggage assistance provided?
Yes, luggage can be tagged at the ferry dock and will be transferred to the property. For departure, please advise the front desk at least 1 hour ahead of departure so we can coordinate luggage delivery back to the ferry docks.
What dining options are available?
There are several different dining options located right on property. The Straits , located inside our historic Mansion , serves breakfast and dinner daily during the season. We also have Horsey’s Pub, our Mansion bar, offering service from 12pm - 10pm. The Backyard and patio area serves wood fired pizzas and casual fare. Our General Store offers grab and go items including specialty coffee and house made ice cream. Please explore more information about our dining options here .
Do you offer activities or experiences?
For guests staying with us, we have weekly activities curated for a range of age groups. Signup for the activities are required. Explore the activity options here .
Is there a dress code?
The Inn at Stonecliffe does not have a formal dress code. Most guests enjoy resort casual attire during their stay. When moving throughout the property, we kindly ask that guests wear appropriate clothing such as shirts, cover-ups, and footwear.
About Mackinac Island
What other things can I do nearby?
From Stonecliffe, explore Mackinac Island’s bike trails, historic sites, shopping downtown, carriage tours, and more adventures. Please explore more things to do on the island here .
When is the best time to visit?
Mackinac Island is charming in spring, summer, and fall. Weather can change quickly, so packing layers and comfortable shoes is recommended.
Can I book group events or weddings?
Yes, we offer spaces and services for weddings, meetings, and group retreats. Learn more about our weddings on our wedding website . Learn more about events on our events page .
Do you offer gift cards or packages?
Yes, gift cards are available for purchase on our website here . We do have stay packages which you can explore on our package page .

The Inn at Stonecliffe
Tranquility & Relaxation Await
Feel the world melt away as you make your way toward a place filled with natural beauty, quiet moments, and the unmistakable magic of the Great Lakes. At The Inn at Stonecliffe, 52 newly renovated guest rooms, suites, and cottages are thoughtfully spread across three distinct accommodations: the historic Mansion featuring 16 guest rooms, the Summer House offering 32 guest rooms, and our 4 private Cottages. Each offering its own sense of place, inspired by the relaxed elegance and timeless character of the Great Lakes’ most storied retreats. From the grandeur of the Mansion to the effortless comfort of the Summer House and the privacy of a cottage tucked among the trees, every stay pairs a distinctly Mackinac sense of place with thoughtful, modern comforts.
Whether you're settling in for a romantic island escape, gathering with family and friends, or simply looking for a place to slow down and stay awhile, you'll find a space that feels uniquely your own. Explore our offerings below.
View 360 Tour
Our Accommodations
The Mansion
Step into modern elegance. Originally built in 1904, The Mansion boasts some of the largest guest rooms on Mackinac Island.
16 Guest Rooms

jsonLd.name: The Inn at Stonecliffe
jsonLd.description: The Inn at Stonecliffe is a historic mansion-turned-luxury resort tucked away in a quiet, secluded wooded area of Mackinac Island, Michigan. Originally built in 1904 as a Tudor/Edwardian estate, the property underwent a massive 40-million-dollar renovation that fully modernized the historic Mansion and Summer House guest rooms. Spanning 15 acres, the property features panoramic bluff-top views of the Mackinac Bridge and the straits connecting Lake Huron and Lake Michigan.
amenityFeature: 51 individually furnished historic rooms, suites, and private three-bedroom cottages
Two outdoor heated pools (including a dedicated family pool and a serene adults-only option)
On-site wellness center featuring a gym, sauna, and massage/esthetician services
Expansive lakeside lawn equipped with fire pits, lawn games, and evening s'mores
Revitalized historic apple orchard with on-site beehives and organic culinary gardens
Complimentary horse-drawn carriage shuttle service upon arrival and departure
Bike pavilion with on-site bicycle rentals and dedicated storage
The Mercantile General Store featuring a barista station, ice cream shop, and artisanal gifts
Complimentary high-speed wireless internet access across all buildings and grounds
